tr.gth: (ท้อง~) ส่วนเบื้องบนที่มองเห็นครอบแผ่นดินอยู่; (ท้อง~) อากาศเบื้องบน
der: ฟ้าร้อง / ฟ้าผ่า
'lord of the sky' — Tai royal title older than the Indic ones
the cosmos in two native syllables — where Indic would say จักรวาล

rule: ฟ้า splits on whether the word looks UP at the vault or happens IN the air. Sense 1 is the visible dome and takes what reaches it or is measured against it — ระฟ้า, ดาดฟ้า, ขอบฟ้า, ค้ำฟ้า — plus the two things named for it, ไก่ฟ้า and เฟื่องฟ้า, and two toponyms. Sense 2 is the atmosphere and everything weather does there: the four lightning-and-thunder words, ฟ้าหลัว the haze, น้ำฟ้า the rain, ขวานฟ้า the neolithic axe believed to fall in a strike, and the three air-domain words ว่ายฟ้า, น่านฟ้า, ทัพฟ้า. ไฟฟ้า belongs there too — the dictionary dates the coinage to พ.ศ. 2427, when electricity reached Siam, and the metaphor it was built on is the lightning, not the dome. Sense 3 takes ดอกฟ้า, a woman out of reach, and sense 4 takes ไพร่ฟ้า, the commoners of the sky-lord. Sense 5, the colour, takes nothing.

notes.h2: 2026-09-02 — heads 100-104, and a mechanical test for false splits
notes.text:
| # | head | filed | false-split | left open | note |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 100 | ลง | 23 | 3 | — | **9 of 16 senses empty** · cluster mis-splits |
| 101 | ฟ้า | 23 | — | 2 | ไฟฟ้า coined พ.ศ. 2427 |
| 102 | คน | 23 | — | — | position decides: initial→2, final→1 |
| 103 | เสีย | 23 | — | — | three rare senses filled by one word each |
| 104 | เอก | 22 | — | — | **the dictionary glosses its own morpheme** |

notes.h2: 2026-09-02 — heads 100-104, and a mechanical test for false splits
notes.h3: ฟ้า — and a category the corpus has no tag for
notes.text:
**ไฟฟ้า is dated.** The dictionary gives คำประสมของ ไฟ + ฟ้า and adds
**บัญญัติตั้งแต่ พ.ศ. 2427 (สมัยรัชกาลที่ 5)** — coined when electricity reached
Siam. Sky-fire, on the lightning and not on the dome, so it files at sense 2 with
ฟ้าผ่า and สายฟ้า rather than at 1.

notes.h2: 2026-09-02 — heads 100-104, and a mechanical test for false splits
notes.h3: ฟ้า — and a category the corpus has no tag for
notes.text:
**หลอดไฟฟ้า and สายไฟฟ้า do not file, and they are not false splits.** The
dictionary gives their parts as หลอด + **ไฟฟ้า** and สาย + **ไฟฟ้า**. The head is
present only at one remove, inside ไฟฟ้า. Filing either under a sense of ฟ้า
would file the sky where the word means electricity; tagging them false-split
would be a lie, because the morpheme really is in there. **The corpus has no
`use` value for "compound of a compound"**, and the queue's NOT_A_COMPOUND set
has only three. Left open with the reasoning attached.

notes.h2: 2026-09-02 — heads 100-104, and a mechanical test for false splits
notes.h3: ฟ้า — and a category the corpus has no tag for
notes.text:
**รถไฟฟ้า is the exception and IS filed, at sense 1.** The dictionary offers two
analyses — `รถ + ไฟฟ้า หรือ รถไฟ + ฟ้า` — and the second makes ฟ้า a direct
constituent. That is the skytrain reading, and the dictionary declines to choose.

notes.h2: 2026-09-02 — heads 100-104, and a mechanical test for false splits
notes.h3: ฟ้า — and a category the corpus has no tag for
notes.text:
**คน sorts by position almost mechanically:** head-initial → sense 2, head-final
→ sense 1. Sense 2's own gloss is broad enough to carry it (one connected with a
thing, an action, a CONDITION, or having that quality), and the source-filed
คนพิการ already sits there. So the sixteen role-and-state words follow, including
**คนดิบ and คนสุก, the raw man and the cooked** — a man not yet ordained and one
who has ordained and left. Sense 1 keeps the head-final words, where คน still
means a human as such: เดนคน too vile to count as one, เกินคน more than one,
หมีคน the sun bear. **คนละ is the single head-initial exception** — ละ is a
distributive particle, not a quality, so the word counts humans rather than
naming one.

notes.h2: 2026-09-02 — heads 100-104, and a mechanical test for false splits
notes.h3: ฟ้า — and a category the corpus has no tag for
notes.text:
**เสีย fills three senses that would otherwise have stood empty, one word each.**
Sense 9 'to pay' takes **เสียผี**, the rite of paying the spirits in compensation
for a sexual transgression — a local custom, and the only word in the head that
reaches that sense. Sense 10 'to lose at gambling' takes ได้เสีย. Sense 15, the
completive particle, takes สั่งเสีย. The other twenty sort on position: head-
initial เสีย + an intangible a person can lose is sense 1 (twelve words), and
head-final เสีย is the adjective — 'is bad' at 8, 'the bad stuff' at 13.
